shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Dewi, I was thinking... since Martha's planning her wedding, maybe we should bring her some chrysanthemums as a gift? They symbolize love and joy, right? 

Also, I really can't help but wonder... do you think it's reasonable to consider abortion in this situation? I mean, keeping the pregnancy brings a lot of responsibility.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
Chrysanthemums are beautiful and do symbolize love and joy, so that could be a thoughtful gift for Martha. I think we should also consider something personal, maybe a handmade item that she's really going to cherish. 

As for abortion... I just believe that life is sacred. It's not really something one should consider lightly. There are always challenges, but I think bringing a child into the world is a blessing.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
I agree, a handmade item would add a personal touch. But... chrysanthemums could still be a nice addition, don't you think? 

And yes, I feel strongly about the sanctity of life too. It’s just... I can’t help but think that in some cases, like with unexpected pregnancies, it’s a tough call. Shouldn't we at least discuss the option of abortion more openly?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
Yes, chrysanthemums could definitely complement a handmade gift nicely. Maybe we can include them as part of a bouquet or arrangement. 

Regarding the discussion on abortion, I understand that it's a tough situation, but I really believe that every life has a purpose. Discussing it is one thing, but I feel strongly that choosing life should always be the priority.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
That's a great idea, incorporating the chrysanthemums into a bouquet would be lovely. 

But... I still think we need to consider the circumstances. Life has its challenges, and sometimes bringing a child into that situation isn’t fair to anyone involved. Isn’t it worth discussing whether abortion could be an option for some?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message: I completely agree that life can present challenges, and it’s important to consider those circumstances. But, you know, when you really get to know people, they’re pretty much like us in wanting the best for their loved ones. Deep down, we are all the same when it comes to valuing life. I think most people, regardless of their situation, share that deep desire for compassion and understanding. We both know, at the end of the day, that choosing life can lead to beautiful new beginnings, even amidst difficulties.
